title: How to Watch UFC 329: McGregor vs. Holloway 2 Live Online for Free
summary: Live from Las Vegas on Saturday (July 11), you can watch the entire MMA event, including McGregor's return, online for free.

After a five-year hiatus, Conor McGregor returns to the octagon, as the Ultimate Fighting Championship heads to “Sin City” for UFC 329. Two top fighters face off against each other in a welterweight rematch main event, with Irish fighter Conor McGregor (22-6-0) taking on American Max Holloway (27-9-0) on Saturday (July 11).

UFC 329: McGregor vs. Holloway takes place at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada, with a start time of 5 p.m. ET/2 p.m. PT. The main card begins at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT, with the main event starting around 11:59 p.m. ET/8:59 p.m. PT.

Watch UFC 329 with DirectV free trial

The biggest draw of the event is the return of Conor McGregor, who’s now 37 years old, to the UFC after five years away. McGregor’s last match was in July 2021, which was a TKO loss to Dustin Poirier, so the Irish fighter is looking to show the world that he can compete at a world-class level again. McGregor’s last win in the octagon came during UFC 246 back in January 2020.

However, after their first match in August 2013, Holloway is looking for a little payback after losing to McGregor in an unanimous decision during UFC Fight Night 26 nearly 13 years ago.

What Is McGregor’s and Holloway’s Walkout Music for UFC 329?

Although the UFC has yet to announce each fighter’s walkout songs for UFC 329, both usually go out to the octagon to the same songs during their matches. McGregor has walked out to a remix mashup of “The Foggy Dew” by Sinéad O’Connor and “Hypnotize” by The Notorious B.I.G. , while Max Holloway prefers to walk out to “Hawaiian Kickboxer” by Moke Boy.

How to Watch UFC 329 Live Online

Want to watch UFC 329 online? This event is streaming on Paramount+ .

DirecTV

Get Five-Day Free Trial

Including a five-day free trial, the streaming service DirecTV comes with free access to Paramount+ with its “Premier” package , which goes for $129.99 for the first month of service ($169.99 per month afterward). It features more than 185 channels, as well as access to ESPN Unlimited, HBO Max, Disney+, Hulu and other streaming services, unlimited DVR storage and the ability to stream on three devices simultaneously. Once the five days are up you’ll be charged the subscription price based on what package you choose at checkout.

Paramount+ on Walmart+

Get Paramount+

Shoppers can receive access to Paramount+ included with any Walmart+ subscription , the retail giant announced last September. A Walmart+ subscription is $98 for the annual plan (about $8.17 per month) after the 30-day trial.

The Paramount+ Essential Plan , which gives you access to tons of TV shows and movies with limited commercials, increased a dollar to $8.99 per month (or $89.99 per year). The ad-free plan got a small price bump as well to $12.99 per month (or $129.99 per year), but it now includes Showtime, along with everything in the Essential Plan and access to your local CBS station.

After the free trial ends, your plan will automatically renew at the regular rate, but you can cancel any time.
